name: Lafiyar Dabbobin Kiwo da Kula da Su
objectives: Yayin duba dabbobinku na kowace rana, gane alamun dabba mai lafiya da mara lafiya, da ware wadda wataƙila ba ta da lafiya, kuna ambaton aƙalla alamun gargaɗi biyar, kuma kuna tuntuɓar likitan dabbobi ko jami'in lafiyar dabbobi
Don dabbobinku a tsawon shekara, tsara abinci da ruwa mai tsabta, har da lokacin rani, ba tare da abinci mai fumfuna ba, kuma ana canja abinci a hankali
Don gidan dabbobinku, duba gidan dabbobi da kafa dokokin tsafta na gona, da gida bushe, mai inuwa, mara cunkoso, ana ware sababbin dabbobi, kuma ana raba marasa lafiya

Tare da likitan dabbobi mai rajista ko jami'in lafiyar dabbobi, amince da rubutaccen jadawalin rigakafi da ajiye alluran rigakafi a wuri mai sanyi kuma kafin su ƙare, da kowace allura, dabbobin, shekarunsu, da lokacin maimaitawa

Don garken kaji, kafa dokokin kare gona daga cututtuka da tsarin abin da za a yi idan cutar Newcastle ta ɓarke, da allurar rigakafi bisa jadawalin likitan dabbobi, da matakan da za a ɗauka idan tsuntsaye suka mutu farat ɗaya

Don garken dabbobinku ko na kajinku, tsara yaƙi da ƙwayoyin cuta masu rayuwa a jiki tare da likitan dabbobi, ajiye bayanan magani, da jera alamun da ke buƙatar likita nan take, kuna rubuta kowane magani tare da lokacin jirarsa

chapters.name: Babi na 1: Kulawar yau da kullum

lessons.title: Darasi 1: Alamun dabba mai lafiya da mara lafiya
lessons.text:
Darasi 1 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Yi ɗan duba lafiya kowace rana kuma ku gane dabbar da wataƙila ba ta da lafiya.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Yayin duba dabbobinku na kowace rana, za ku iya gane alamun dabba mai lafiya da mara lafiya, da ware wadda wataƙila ba ta da lafiya, kuna ambaton aƙalla alamun gargaɗi biyar, kuma kuna tuntuɓar likitan dabbobi ko jami'in lafiyar dabbobi.
Ku ne kuka fi sanin dabbobinku. Kallo a kowace rana, a lokacin ciyarwa ko tatsa, yana gano rashin lafiya da wuri, lokacin da maganinta ya fi araha kuma kafin ta yaɗu.
Dabba mai lafiya tana farke kuma tana son sanin abubuwa, tana tsayawa da tafiya yadda ya kamata, tana ci da sha sosai, kuma shanu, awaki da tumaki suna tuƙa (cud) idan suna hutawa. Idanunta suna haske kuma a fili, hancinta mai tsabta ne, gashinta ko gashin fukafukanta yana da santsi da ƙyalli, numfashinta a hankali yake, kuma kashinta da fitsarinta suna kama da na yau da kullum. Kaza mai lafiya tana motsi sosai, jan zakararta (comb) yana haske, kuma tana yin ƙwai kamar yadda ta saba.
Alamun gargaɗi: tsayawa ita kaɗai nesa da sauran, sunkuyar da kai, rashin ci ko rashin tuƙa, idanu marasa haske ko masu zubar ruwa, hanci mai zubar ruwa, tari ko numfashi da sauri, gudawa ko jini a kashi, ɗingishi, kumburi, raunuka, raguwar nono ko ƙwai farat ɗaya, fukafukai a hargitse, karkacewar wuya a tsuntsaye, ko mutuwa farat ɗaya. Ku ware dabba mara lafiya daga sauran, ku tuntuɓi likitan dabbobi ko jami'in lafiyar dabbobi.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku duba kowace dabba sau ɗaya a rana, a lokacin ciyarwa ko tatsa.
- Ku duba: tana farke, tana tsayawa da tafiya daidai, tana ci, tana tuƙa.
- Ku ƙara dubawa: idanu, hanci, gashi ko fukafukai, numfashi, kashi.
- Ku lura da duk wata raguwar nono ko ƙwai.
- Ku ware duk dabbar da ke da alamun gargaɗi.
- Ku rubuta abin da kuka gani, ku kira likitan dabbobi ko jami'in lafiyar dabbobi.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Tuƙa (chewing the cud): lokacin da shanu, awaki da tumaki suka dawo da abinci baki suka sake tauna shi; alama ce ta lafiya.
- Ware (isolate): ajiye dabba mara lafiya nesa da sauran.
- Jami'in lafiyar dabbobi (animal health officer): ma'aikaci da aka horar, na gwamnati ko mai zaman kansa, da ke taimakon manoma kan lafiyar dabbobi.
Gwada yanzu: Gobe a lokacin ciyarwa, ku duba kowace dabba da wannan jeri: tana farke, tana ci, tana tuƙa, idanu, hanci, gashi, numfashi, kashi. Ku rubuta layi ɗaya ga kowace dabba (ko ga kowane ɗaki na kaji). Ku yi alama a kan duk wadda za ku sa ido a kai ko ku kira likitan dabbobi game da ita.
Yanzu za ku iya yin duba lafiya kowace rana da gane alamun dabba mara lafiya.

check.q: Wace alama ce ta gargaɗi a kaza?
options: Yin ƙwai kamar yadda ta saba
Tana motsi kuma tana ci sosai
check.why: Fukafukai a hargitse alamar gargaɗi ce; kaza mai lafiya tana motsi kuma jan zakararta yana haske.

check.q: Kuna da aiki sosai, kuma kuna shirin duba dabbobinku sau ɗaya kawai a mako. Mene ne haɗarin?
options: Za a gano rashin lafiya a makare, lokacin da maganinta ya fi tsada kuma wataƙila ta yaɗu
check.why: Kallo kowace rana yana gano rashin lafiya da wuri, lokacin da maganinta ya fi araha kuma kafin ta yaɗu.

lessons.title: Darasi 2: Abinci da ruwa
lessons.text:
Darasi 2 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Tsara abinci da ruwa mai tsabta don dabbobinku a tsawon shekara, har da lokacin rani.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Don dabbobinku a tsawon shekara, za ku iya tsara abinci da ruwa mai tsabta, har da lokacin rani, ba tare da abinci mai fumfuna ba, kuma ana canja abinci a hankali.
Ruwa shi ne na farko. Dabbobi suna buƙatar ruwa mai tsabta kowace rana, da ƙari a lokacin zafi; saniya mai tatsa tana shan ruwa fiye da wadda ba a tatsa, kuma nono yana raguwa da sauri idan babu isasshen ruwa. Ku tsaftace kwamin ruwa da kwanonin sha, ku ajiye su a inuwa, kuma kada ku taɓa barin tsuntsaye su sha ruwa mai datti da ke kwance.
Shanu, awaki da tumaki suna buƙatar abinci mai yawan zare (roughage): ciyawa, ciyawar kiwo kamar Napier grass, Rhodes grass, desmodium ko lucerne, da ragowar amfanin gona kamar karan masara da ganyen wake. Dabbobin da ake tatsa, masu ciki ko masu girma suna kuma buƙatar abinci mai kuzari da furotin. Awaki suna kuma cin ganyen ƙananan bishiyoyi da itatuwa. Ku ba su gishiri ko dutsen lasa (mineral lick) kamar yadda likitan dabbobi ko jami'in faɗakarwar noma ya ba da shawara. Kajin ƙwai ko na nama suna buƙatar cikakken abinci; kajin ƙauye suna yawo neman abinci, amma suna ƙara ƙwai da girma idan aka ƙara musu ɗan hatsi, ganye da ruwa mai tsabta.
Ku shirya don lokacin rani: ku shuka ciyawar kiwo, kuma ku ajiye busasshiyar ciyawa (hay), silage ko busassun ragowar amfanin gona lokacin da suke da yawa. Kada ku taɓa ba da abinci mai fumfuna: fumfuna yana iya ɗauke da aflatoxin, guba da ke cutar da dabbobi kuma tana shiga nono da ƙwai. Ku canja abinci a hankali cikin kwanaki da yawa don guje wa ciwon ciki.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku ba da ruwa mai tsabta kowace rana; ƙari a lokacin zafi da ga dabbobin da ake tatsa.
- Ku tsaftace kwamin ruwa da kwanonin sha; ku ajiye su a inuwa.
- Ku tsara abinci mai yawan zare: makiyaya, ciyawar kiwo da ragowar amfanin gona.
- Ku ƙara abinci mai kuzari da furotin ga dabbobin da ake tatsa, masu ciki da masu girma.
- Ku ajiye busasshiyar ciyawa, silage ko ragowar amfanin gona don lokacin rani.
- Ku zubar da abinci mai fumfuna; ku canja abinci a hankali.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Abinci mai yawan zare (roughage): abinci mai girma kamar ciyawa, busasshiyar ciyawa da ragowar amfanin gona.
- Ciyawar kiwo (fodder): amfanin gonar da ake shukawa don ciyar da dabbobi, kamar Napier grass ko lucerne.
- Silage: ɗanyar ciyawar kiwo da aka ajiye a wurin da iska ba ta shiga don ta daɗe watanni.
- Dutsen lasa (mineral lick): dunƙulen gishiri da ma'adinai da dabbobi ke lasa.
Gwada yanzu: Ku jera abincin da dabbobinku ke samu yanzu da inda kowanne ke fitowa. Ku yi alama a kan waɗanda ke ƙarewa a lokacin rani, ku rubuta hanya ɗaya ta ajiye ko shuka ƙari kafin lokacin. Ku duba kowane kwanon sha yau, ku tsaftace duk wanda ke da datti.
Yanzu za ku iya tsara abinci da ruwa mai tsabta don dabbobinku a tsawon shekara.

check.q: Wanne daga cikin waɗannan abinci ne mai yawan zare ga shanu?
check.why: Abinci mai yawan zare ya haɗa da ciyawa, ciyawar kiwo da ragowar amfanin gona kamar karan masara da ganyen wake.

check.q: A ranar zafi, kwamin ruwan saniyarku mai tatsa babu komai kuma yana da datti. Me za ku yi?
options: Ku ba ta ƙarin busasshen abinci a maimakon haka
Ku tsaftace shi ku cika shi da ruwa mai tsabta, a inuwa
Ku bar ta ta sha daga kududdufin ruwa mai kwance
check.why: Dabbobi suna buƙatar ruwa mai tsabta kowace rana, ƙari a lokacin zafi, kuma nono yana raguwa da sauri ba tare da shi ba.

lessons.title: Darasi 3: Gidan dabbobi da tsafta
lessons.text:
Darasi 3 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Duba gidan dabbobinku kuma ku kafa dokokin tsafta uku don gonarku.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Don gidan dabbobinku, za ku iya duba gidan dabbobi da kafa dokokin tsafta na gona, da gida bushe, mai inuwa, mara cunkoso, ana ware sababbin dabbobi, kuma ana raba marasa lafiya.
Gida mai kyau yana sa dabbobi su zauna a bushe, a inuwa, lafiya daga ɓarayi da namun daji masu farauta, kuma ba tare da cunkoso ba. Yana buƙatar iska mai kyau ba tare da iskar sanyi mai shiga ba, ƙasa bushe da ke zubar da ruwa, da isasshen wuri da kowace dabba za ta kwanta, ta ci, ta sha. Gida mai cunkoso, mai danshi da datti yana yaɗa cututtuka, tsutsotsi da matsalolin ƙafa.
Ku tsaftace shi: ku kwashe kashi da shimfiɗar da ta jiƙe akai-akai (tana zama taki mai kyau), ku tsaftace kwanonin abinci da na sha, ku kuma yaƙi ƙudaje, ɓeraye da tsuntsayen daji. Ga kaji, ku yi amfani da busasshiyar shimfiɗa (litter) ku canja ta idan ta jiƙe. Ku wanke hannu bayan kun taɓa dabbobi, musamman marasa lafiya.
Ku hana cuta shiga, kuma ku hana ta fita: ku ajiye sababbin dabbobi nesa da garkenku na tsawon lokacin da likitan dabbobi ya ce kafin ku haɗa su, kuma ku ajiye marasa lafiya a wani ɗaki dabam. Wasu cututtukan dabbobi suna kama mutane ma, kamar brucellosis da anthrax (cutar baƙin dauda). Idan dabba ta mutu farat ɗaya tana zubar da jini daga hanci ko wasu kafofi, kada ku buɗe gawarta; ku hana mutane da dabbobi kusantar ta, ku kira likitan dabbobi nan take. Ku rabu da matattun dabbobi yadda likitan dabbobi ko jami'in lafiyar dabbobi ya ce.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku duba gida: bushe, mai inuwa, mai iska, yana zubar da ruwa, ba cunkoso.
- Ku kwashe kashi da shimfiɗa mai jiƙe akai-akai.
- Ku tsaftace kwanonin abinci da na sha; ku yaƙi ƙudaje da ɓeraye.
- Ku ware sababbin dabbobi kafin ku haɗa su, kamar yadda likitan dabbobi ya ce.
- Ku ajiye ɗaki dabam don dabbobi marasa lafiya.
- Ku wanke hannu bayan taɓa dabbobi; ku kira likitan dabbobi game da mutuwa farat ɗaya.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Shimfiɗa (litter): busasshen abin shimfiɗa kamar gutsattsarin katako a ƙasan gidan kaji.
- Keɓewa (quarantine): ajiye sababbin dabbobi ko marasa lafiya dabam don hana cuta yaɗuwa.
- Cutar dabba zuwa mutum (zoonosis): cutar da za ta iya wucewa tsakanin dabbobi da mutane.
- Gawa (carcass): jikin matacciyar dabba.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- FAO: Kyawawan matakan kare gona daga cututtuka (biosecurity) a kiwon kaji ƙanana da na yawo a Kenya
Gwada yanzu: Ku zaga gidan dabbobinku ko garkensu da wannan jeri: bushe, mai inuwa, mai iska, yana zubar da ruwa, ba cunkoso, kwanonin sha masu tsabta. Ku rubuta abu ɗaya da za ku gyara a wannan makon, da dokokin tsafta uku ga duk wanda ke aiki da dabbobinku.
Yanzu za ku iya duba gidan dabbobi ku tsaftace shi, ware dabbobi marasa lafiya da sababbi, da ɗaukar mataki lafiya idan dabba ta mutu farat ɗaya.

check.q: Me yasa za a kwashe kashi da shimfiɗa mai jiƙe akai-akai?
options: Gida mai datti da danshi yana yaɗa cututtuka, tsutsotsi da matsalolin ƙafa
Don gidan ya yi kama da babu komai
check.why: Gida mai cunkoso, mai danshi da datti yana yaɗa cututtuka, tsutsotsi da matsalolin ƙafa.

check.q: Ruwan sama ya shiga gidan kajinku kuma shimfiɗar ta jiƙe. Me za ku yi?
options: Ku canja shimfiɗar da ta jiƙe da busasshiya, ku gyara wurin da ruwa ke shiga
Ku bar ta ta bushe da kanta
Ku fitar da tsuntsayen cikin ruwan sama
check.why: Kaji suna buƙatar busasshiyar shimfiɗa; ana canja wadda ta jiƙe kuma a gyara dalilin.

chapters.name: Babi na 2: Rigakafi da maganin cututtuka

lessons.title: Darasi 4: Jadawalin rigakafi tare da likitan dabbobi na yankinku
lessons.text:
Darasi 4 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Amince da rubutaccen jadawalin rigakafi tare da likitan dabbobi mai rajista, kuma ku kiyaye alluran rigakafi su yi aiki.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Tare da likitan dabbobi mai rajista ko jami'in lafiyar dabbobi, za ku iya amince da rubutaccen jadawalin rigakafi da ajiye alluran rigakafi a wuri mai sanyi kuma kafin su ƙare, da kowace allura, dabbobin, shekarunsu, da lokacin maimaitawa.
Alluran rigakafi suna hana manyan cututtukan dabbobi da yawa da kuɗi ƙasa da na magani nesa ba kusa ba. Waɗanne alluran rigakafi dabbobinku ke buƙata, da yaushe, ya dogara da ƙasarku, yankinku da cututtukan da ke akwai a can. Misalan da aka saba sun haɗa da cutar ƙafa da baki (foot-and-mouth), lumpy skin disease, anthrax da blackquarter a shanu; peste des petits ruminants (PPR) a awaki da tumaki; da cutar Newcastle, Gumboro da fowl pox a kaji. Likitan dabbobi ko jami'in lafiyar dabbobi da ya san yankinku ne kaɗai zai iya ba da jadawalin da ya dace.
Ku roƙi likitan dabbobinku ya rubuta kalandar shekara: kowace allura, ga waɗanne dabbobi, a wane shekaru, da yaushe za a maimaita. Ku yi amfani da likitan dabbobi mai rajista ko ma'aikacin lafiyar dabbobi da aka horar. A Najeriya, Veterinary Council of Nigeria (Majalisar Likitocin Dabbobi ta Najeriya) ce ke ajiye rajistar likitocin dabbobi; a Kenya, Kenya Veterinary Board tana yi wa likitocin dabbobi da mataimakansu (para-vets) rajista; a Ghana, Veterinary Services Directorate ta Ma'aikatar Abinci da Noma (MoFA) ce ke gudanar da hidimomin lafiyar dabbobi da kamfe-kamfen rigakafi. Kamfe-kamfen gwamnati wani lokaci kyauta ne ko masu araha, don haka ku saurari sanarwa.
Alluran rigakafi kayayyaki ne masu rai ko masu saurin lalacewa. Ku saya daga shagunan magungunan dabbobi masu lasisi (agrovets) kawai, ku duba ranar ƙarewa, ku ajiye su a sanyi (a akwatin sanyi ko firiji, nesa da rana) tun daga shago har zuwa dabba, kuma ku yi amfani da su yadda abin da ke jikin kwalin (label) da likitan dabbobi suka ce. Allurar rigakafi da ta yi zafi wataƙila ba za ta kare dabbobinku ba.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku tambayi likitan dabbobi mai rajista ko jami'in lafiyar dabbobi waɗanne cututtuka ne haɗari a yankinku.
- Ku karɓi rubutacciyar kalandar shekara: allura, dabbobi, shekaru, ranakun maimaitawa.
- Ku sayi alluran rigakafi daga agrovets masu lasisi kawai; ku duba ranar ƙarewa.
- Ku ajiye alluran rigakafi a sanyi tun daga shago har zuwa dabba.
- Ku yi amfani da su daidai yadda abin da ke jikin kwali da likitan dabbobi suka ce.
- Ku rubuta kowace allura: rana, dabbobi, allura, lambar batch, wanda ya yi ta.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Allurar rigakafi (vaccine): kayan da ke koya wa jikin dabba yaƙi da cuta kafin ta kamu.
- Jadawalin rigakafi: kalandar waɗanne alluran rigakafi za a yi, ga waɗanne dabbobi, da yaushe.
- Sarkar sanyi (cold chain): ajiye alluran rigakafi a sanyi tun daga mai yin su har zuwa dabba.
- PPR: peste des petits ruminants, cuta mai kisa ta ƙwayar cuta (virus) a awaki da tumaki.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- Majalisar Likitocin Dabbobi ta Najeriya (Veterinary Council of Nigeria): rajistar likitocin dabbobi
Gwada yanzu: Ku kira ko ku ziyarci likitan dabbobi ko jami'in lafiyar dabbobi na yankinku ku tambaya: daga waɗanne cututtuka ya kamata in yi wa dabbobina rigakafi a nan, kuma yaushe? Ku rubuta amsarsu a matsayin kalandar watanni 12, kuma ku ajiye lambar likitan dabbobin a wayarku.
Yanzu za ku iya samun jadawalin rigakafi daga likitan dabbobi mai rajista, da ajiye alluran rigakafi a sanyi don su yi aiki.

check.q: Wace ce cutar kaji da ake hanawa da allurar rigakafi?
check.why: Cutar Newcastle, Gumboro da fowl pox cututtukan kaji ne da aka saba, waɗanda alluran rigakafi ke hanawa.

check.q: Likitan dabbobinku ya yi alluran rigakafi na farko amma bai rubuta komai ba. Me za ku nema?
options: Allurar rigakafi ga kowace cuta a duniya
Rubutacciyar kalandar shekara: kowace allura, waɗanne dabbobi, a wane shekaru da yaushe za a maimaita
check.why: Rubutacciyar kalanda daga likitan dabbobi tana sa kowace allura ta kasance a kan lokaci.

lessons.title: Darasi 5: Kare kaji daga cututtuka da cutar Newcastle
lessons.text:
Darasi 5 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Kafa dokokin kare gona daga cututtuka da za su hana cutar Newcastle da sauran cututtuka shiga garken kajinku.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Don garken kaji, za ku iya kafa dokokin kare gona daga cututtuka da tsarin abin da za a yi idan cutar Newcastle ta ɓarke, da allurar rigakafi bisa jadawalin likitan dabbobi, da matakan da za a ɗauka idan tsuntsaye suka mutu farat ɗaya.
Cutar Newcastle tana ɗaya daga cikin cututtukan kaji mafi tsanani a Afirka. Hukumar Lafiyar Dabbobi ta Duniya (WOAH) ta bayyana alamomi kamar haki, tari da atishawa; alamun jijiyoyi kamar rawar jiki, shanyewa da karkacewar wuya; gudawa; da raguwar ƙwai. Mutuwa za ta iya kai kashi 100 cikin 100 na garke, kuma kusan dukkan tsuntsayen garke za su iya kamuwa cikin 'yan kwanaki.
WOAH ta bayyana cewa tana yaɗuwa ta hanyar taɓa tsuntsaye marasa lafiya da kashinsu, da kuma ta abinci, ruwa, kayan aiki da tufafin da cutar ta ɓata. Shi yasa kare gona daga cututtuka (biosecurity), wato matakai masu sauƙi na yau da kullum da ke hana ƙwayoyin cuta shiga, yake da muhimmanci kamar allurar rigakafi. Jagorar FAO ga ƙananan garken kaji a Kenya ta jaddada cewa yawancin waɗannan matakai ba sa ci kuɗi da yawa, ko ba sa ci kwata-kwata.
Ku yi wa dukkan garken rigakafin cutar Newcastle bisa jadawalin da likitan dabbobinku ya bayar. Ga kajin ƙauye, FAO ta bayyana alluran rigakafi masu jure zafi (kamar I-2) da za a iya bayarwa ta digon ido; ku tambayi jami'in lafiyar dabbobi abin da ake samu. Idan tsuntsaye da yawa suka yi rashin lafiya ko suka mutu farat ɗaya, ku kulle garken a ciki, ku sanar da likitan dabbobi ko jami'in lafiyar dabbobi nan take, kuma kada ku sayar ko ku motsa tsuntsaye. WOAH ta ba da shawarar barin gidan da aka tsaftace babu kaji na kwanaki 21 kafin a sake saka sababbi bayan ɓarkewar cuta.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku hana baƙi shiga gidan kaji; ku wanke hannu ku yi amfani da kwanon maganin ƙafa ko takalma na dabam.
- Ku sayi tsuntsaye daga majiyoyi amintattu masu lafiya kawai; ku fara ware sababbin tsuntsaye.
- Ku hana tsuntsayen daji, ɓeraye da kajin wasu mutane kusantar abinci da ruwa.
- Ku tsaftace ku kashe ƙwayoyin cuta a kwanonin sha, na abinci da akwatunan kaji akai-akai.
- Ku yi wa dukkan garken rigakafi bisa jadawalin likitan dabbobi.
- Idan tsuntsaye suka yi rashin lafiya ko suka mutu farat ɗaya: ku kulle garken, ku kira likitan dabbobi, kada ku sayar ko ku motsa tsuntsaye.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Kare gona daga cututtuka (biosecurity): matakai masu sauƙi na yau da kullum da ke hana ƙwayoyin cuta shiga gona da hana su yaɗuwa.
- Cutar Newcastle: cutar kaji ta ƙwayar cuta (virus) mai saurin yaɗuwa da za ta iya kashe dukkan garke.
- Kwanon maganin ƙafa (foot dip): tire mai maganin kashe ƙwayoyin cuta da mutane ke takawa kafin su shiga gidan dabbobi.
- Allurar rigakafi mai jure zafi (thermostable vaccine): allurar rigakafi da ta fi jure zafi, mai amfani a ƙauye; har yanzu dole a ajiye ta a sanyi gwargwadon iko.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- Hukumar Lafiyar Dabbobi ta Duniya (WOAH): cutar Newcastle
- FAO: Cutar Newcastle a kajin gida na ƙauye
- FAO: Kyawawan matakan kare gona daga cututtuka (biosecurity) a kiwon kaji ƙanana da na yawo a Kenya
Gwada yanzu: Ku rubuta dokoki biyar na kare kajinku daga cututtuka ku liƙa su a ƙofar gidan kaji. Sannan ku tambayi likitan dabbobi ko jami'in lafiyar dabbobi yaushe ya kamata a sake yi wa garkenku rigakafin cutar Newcastle, ku ƙara shi a kalandarku.
Yanzu za ku iya kare garken kaji daga cutar Newcastle ta hanyar kare gona daga cututtuka da allurar rigakafi, da ɗaukar mataki da sauri idan tsuntsaye suka mutu.

check.q: Mene ne kare gona daga cututtuka (biosecurity)?
options: Matakai masu sauƙi na yau da kullum da ke hana ƙwayoyin cuta shiga gona
check.why: Kare gona daga cututtuka matakai ne na yau da kullum da ke hana ƙwayoyin cuta shiga, kuma yawancinsu ba sa ci kuɗi da yawa ko kwata-kwata.

check.q: Maƙwabci wanda tsuntsayensa suka yi rashin lafiya yana son ararar tiren ƙwai da kwanonin abincinku. Me za ku yi?
options: Ku ba shi aro ku sake amfani da su idan sun dawo
Kada ku raba kayan aiki, domin ƙwayoyin cuta suna yaɗuwa a kansu
Ku ba shi aro na kwana ɗaya kawai
Ku musanya tsuntsayenku a maimakon haka
check.why: Cutar Newcastle tana yaɗuwa ta abinci, ruwa, kayan aiki da tufafin da cutar ta ɓata.

lessons.title: Darasi 6: Ƙwayoyin cuta masu rayuwa a jiki, bayanai da lokacin kiran likita
lessons.text:
Darasi 6 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Tsara yaƙi da ƙwayoyin cuta masu rayuwa a jiki tare da likitan dabbobi, ku ajiye bayanan magani, kuma ku san alamun da ke buƙatar likitan dabbobi nan take.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Don garken dabbobinku ko na kajinku, za ku iya tsara yaƙi da ƙwayoyin cuta masu rayuwa a jiki tare da likitan dabbobi, ajiye bayanan magani, da jera alamun da ke buƙatar likita nan take, kuna rubuta kowane magani tare da lokacin jirarsa.
Tsutsotsin da ke cikin hanji, da kaska, ƙwarƙwata (mites) da ƙuma a waje, suna shan jini, suna rage girma kuma suna yaɗa cututtuka; kaska suna yaɗa East Coast fever a shanu a Gabashin Afirka. Alamun tsutsotsi sun haɗa da rashin girma, gashi mai kaushi, babban ciki, gudawa da fatar ido ko dasashi mara launi (fari-fari). Ku rage waɗannan ƙwayoyin cuta da gida mai tsabta da bushe, da canja wa dabbobin kiwo sabon makiyaya, da rashin cunkoso. Likitan dabbobinku zai iya faɗa muku yaushe za a ba da maganin tsutsotsi, a tsoma su a maganin kaska ko a fesa musu, da wane magani. Koyaushe ku yi amfani da yawan maganin da ke jikin kwali ko wanda likitan dabbobi ya bayar: ƙasa da shi yana sa tsutsotsi da kaska su daina jin maganin, kuma ƙari a kansa zai iya cutar da dabbar.
Magunguna suna barin saura a jiki. Kowane magani yana da lokacin jira (withdrawal period): lokacin bayan magani kafin a iya sayarwa ko cin nono, ƙwai ko naman wannan dabbar. FAO ta jaddada yin aiki tare da likitan dabbobinku kan tsarin lafiya da rubuta kowane magani tare da lokacin jirarsa. Kada ku taɓa amfani da maganin ƙwayoyin cuta (antibiotics) don sa dabbobi su yi girma da sauri, ko ba tare da shawarar likitan dabbobi ba.
Bayanai suna mayar da tsammani zuwa sani. Ga kowace dabba ko garken kaji, ku rubuta: shaidarta, haihuwa, alluran rigakafi, magunguna (rana, magani, wanda ya ba da shi, ranar da lokacin jira zai ƙare), nauyi ko abin da take samarwa, da mutuwa. Littafin rubutu ya isa; haka ma takardar lissafi (spreadsheet) a waya. Ku kira likitan dabbobi nan take don: mutuwa farat ɗaya, dabbobi da yawa marasa lafiya a lokaci ɗaya, dabbar da ba ta ci ba fiye da kwana ɗaya, haihuwa mai wahala, zubar jini mai yawa, alamun jijiyoyi, ko duk wata cuta da gwamnatinku ta ce dole a sanar da ita.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku roƙi likitan dabbobinku tsarin yaƙi da ƙwayoyin cuta masu rayuwa a jiki: yaushe za a ba da maganin tsutsotsi da tsoma ko fesa maganin kaska, da da wane magani.
- Ku yi amfani da yawan maganin da ke jikin kwali ko daga likitan dabbobi, ba na tsammani ba.
- Ku kai dabbobin kiwo sabon makiyaya; ku ajiye gida a bushe.
- Ku rubuta kowane magani tare da ranar da lokacin jira zai ƙare.
- Kada ku sayar da nono, ƙwai ko nama kafin lokacin jira ya ƙare.
- Ku kira likitan dabbobi nan take don mutuwa farat ɗaya, dabbobi da yawa marasa lafiya, haihuwa mai wahala ko alamun jijiyoyi.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Ƙwayar cuta mai rayuwa a jiki (parasite): tsutsa, kaska, ƙwarƙwata ko ƙuma da ke rayuwa a kan dabba ko a cikinta kuma tana cutar da ita.
- Maganin tsutsotsi (deworming): ba da magani don kashe tsutsotsi a cikin dabba.
- Lokacin jira (withdrawal period): lokacin bayan magani kafin a iya sayarwa ko cin nono, ƙwai ko nama.
- Daina jin magani (resistance): lokacin da tsutsotsi, kaska ko ƙwayoyin cuta suka tsira daga maganin da a da yake kashe su.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- FAO: Amfani da magungunan ƙwayoyin cuta (antimicrobials) a hankali a aladu da kaji (likitocin dabbobi, tsarin lafiya, lokacin jira)
- Hukumar Lafiyar Dabbobi ta Duniya (WOAH): cutar Newcastle
Gwada yanzu: Aikin ƙarshe: ku rubuta tsarin lafiyarku mai shafi ɗaya. Ku haɗa da duban ku na kowace rana, tsarin abinci da ruwa, dokokin gidan dabbobi, kalandar rigakafi daga likitan dabbobinku, dokokin kare gona daga cututtuka, tsarin yaƙi da ƙwayoyin cuta masu rayuwa a jiki, bayanan da za ku ajiye, da alamun da ke nufin ku kira likitan dabbobi, tare da sunan likitan da lambar wayarsa a sama.
Yanzu za ku iya yaƙi da ƙwayoyin cuta masu rayuwa a jiki tare da likitan dabbobi, ajiye bayanan magani tare da lokutan jira, da sanin lokacin kiran likitan dabbobi.
Yadda ake duba aikinku na ƙarshe:
Abin da muke dubawa Har yanzu bai kai ba Ya cika Ya wuce Duba na kowace rana Babu duba na kowace rana, ko ba a jera alamun gargaɗi ba. Duba na kowace rana a lokacin ciyarwa ko tatsa, tare da manyan alamun gargaɗi da abin da za a yi. An daidaita duban ga kowane irin dabbar da ake kiwo. Abinci, ruwa da gidan dabbobi Babu tsarin lokacin rani, ko babu dokokin gidan dabbobi da tsafta. Abinci da ruwa mai tsabta a tsawon shekara tare da tsarin lokacin rani, da dokoki biyu na gidan dabbobi da tsafta. Ya haɗa da shuka ko ajiye ciyawar kiwo da ware sababbin dabbobi. Jadawalin rigakafi Babu jadawali, ko wanda ba a amince da shi da likitan dabbobi ba. Rubutaccen jadawali daga likitan dabbobi mai rajista, tare da yadda ake ajiye alluran rigakafi a sanyi kuma kafin su ƙare. Ya ambaci kamfe-kamfen gwamnati da sunan likitan dabbobi da lambar wayarsa. Kare gona daga cututtuka Babu dokokin kare gona daga cututtuka. Dokokin kare gona daga cututtuka, kuma ga kaji, rigakafin Newcastle da matakan da za a ɗauka idan tsuntsaye suka mutu farat ɗaya. Ana amfani da matakai masu araha kamar wanke hannu da kwanon maganin ƙafa. Ƙwayoyin cuta masu rayuwa a jiki, bayanai da likitan dabbobi Babu bayanai, ko an yi tsammanin yawan magani. An tsara yaƙi da ƙwayoyin cuta masu rayuwa a jiki tare da likitan dabbobi, akwai bayanan magani tare da lokutan jira, da alamun da ke nufin a kira likitan dabbobi nan take. Bayanan sun kuma haɗa da haihuwa, nauyi ko abin da ake samarwa, da mutuwa. Don cin nasara: "Ya cika" ko "Ya wuce" a kowane layi. Idan wani layi "Bai kai ba tukuna", ku gyara wannan sashe na tsarin ku sake dubawa.

check.q: Wace cuta ce kaska ke yaɗawa a shanu a Gabashin Afirka?
check.why: Kaska suna yaɗa East Coast fever a shanu a Gabashin Afirka.

check.q: Kun yi wa akuya magani yau. Me za ku rubuta a cikin bayanai?
options: Babu komai, idan akuyar ta yi kama da ta warke
Rana, magani, wanda ya ba da shi, da yaushe lokacin jira zai ƙare
check.why: Rubuta kowane magani tare da lokacin jirarsa yana sa nono da nama su zama lafiyayyu don sayarwa da ci.
